comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: Seems an interesting aide skill to learn. How does this work, and does this apply on our character or the aide? It says effectiveness varies based on lieutenant trait, so does that mean they can fill our gauge instantly like max (5) if the trait is 100?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Applies to your character only. You know the action gauge (purple, lower right) that fills up over time in land battles and allows you to use techs/items for point costs? At 100 trait points, you will begin a battle with a full gauge to use at your leisure.
